name: Dark Studio
note: Near-black, refined, a single blue accent.
thesis: Swiss-level restraint relit in the dark: deep near-black surfaces, generous negative space, crisp tight-tracked type, and exactly one disciplined blue accent that earns every appearance.

tokens.fontMono: Geist Mono, ui-monospace, SF Mono, monospace (labels / numbers / metadata, uppercased, +0.08–0.14em tracking)
tokens.radius: 12px on cards/panels, 9px on buttons, 6px on tags
tokens.border: 1px hairlines: #1d2029 default, #2a2e3a on hover/focus; faint blue bleed (#3b82f6 fading to line) on full rules
tokens.motion: cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) ease-out; 150–300ms; underlines/borders grow, accent glows softly; marquee respects prefers-reduced-motion

layout: A 12-column 1200px-max modular grid with 28px gutters. Numbered, labelled sections (00–08) stacked vertically, each separated by a hairline rule and breathing 76px of vertical padding. A mono running head with the brand mark; an asymmetric hero (9 cols of display type + a 2-col left-hairline aside of vitals); a full-bleed masked client marquee; even 3- and 4-up grids for figures, capabilities, team; a flush-left typographic work index; 4-up preview cards with a grid-lit canvas; a two-column contact (budget pad + brief card). Everything flush-left, restraint over decoration.

sections.name: running-head
sections.what: Breadcrumbs + glowing blue square brand mark (FIELDWORK) + est. tag + mono nav.
sections.restyle: Breadcrumbs inherit re-pointed dark fg tokens; the brand mark is a solid-blue rounded square with a soft accent glow ring; Badge is reskinned to a mono uppercase hairline 'tag'.

sections.name: hero
sections.what: Eyebrow index line, large two-tone display headline (one word in blue), lede, primary+ghost CTAs, and a left-hairline aside of availability/location/disciplines.
sections.restyle: Display type at clamp(2.7rem,7vw,5.6rem), -0.035em tracking; primary Button is forced to solid blue with a glow shadow, ghost Button is a hairline outline that turns blue on hover; Separator becomes a faint dark hairline.

sections.name: client-ticker
sections.what: Infinite horizontal marquee of client names with blue dot separators, edge-masked.
sections.restyle: Hand-rolled CSS marquee (no kit component); muted ink that lifts on hover; mask-image fade at both edges; animation disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

sections.name: figures
sections.what: Four tabular-num studio stats (founded, projects, people, awards) with selective blue emphasis.
sections.restyle: Hand-rolled figure blocks topped by hairlines; large -0.04em display numerals, mono uppercase labels; one stat's number tinted blue for rhythm.

sections.name: capabilities
sections.what: Four-up service columns (design systems, product, engineering, brand) each with number, title, body, and mono tags.
sections.restyle: Hairline-topped columns that grow a 48px blue rule on hover; Heading reads the dark fg token; Badges are mono uppercase hairline tags.

sections.name: featured-work
sections.what: Three preview cards, each a grid-lit dark canvas with a large two-tone monogram glyph + title/discipline/award, stretched-link to the project.
sections.restyle: Hand-rolled preview card with a dotted-grid canvas masked from a top blue glow; hover lifts a blue-tinted shadow ring; one Inertia <Link> stretched over the card (no nested anchors).

sections.name: selected-work-index
sections.what: Paginated flush-left typographic index of all projects (num / title / discipline / year↗) with a discipline Pillbox filter.
sections.restyle: Rows are hairline-separated; title goes blue on row hover; Pillbox + Pagination inherit dark field tokens (near-black field, hairline border, blue focus ring); stretched <Link> per row.

sections.name: how-we-work
sections.what: Tabs across Process (Timeline), Principles (2-up columns), and Questions (Accordion).
sections.restyle: Tabs underline variant restyled to mono uppercase labels with a blue active label; Timeline dots recolored to dark line + one blue accent step; Accordion flattened to hairline rows whose triggers turn blue on hover.

sections.name: about
sections.what: A large pull-quote (one word blue) beside a muted supporting paragraph, eyebrow in the left column.
sections.restyle: Hand-rolled quote at clamp(1.35rem,2.6vw,2.1rem); Text uses the muted dark token; asymmetric 3+8 column split.

sections.name: team
sections.what: Four-up people cards: avatar + name + mono role, hairline-topped.
sections.restyle: Avatars use kit fallback initials on dark; columns topped by hairlines; roles in mono tertiary ink.

sections.name: recognition
sections.what: Awards Table (year/project/award) beside a clients Badge cloud and a press list.
sections.restyle: Table recolored to transparent dark rows, mono uppercase header, hairline rules, blue-free body that hover-tints the row band; Badges are mono tags; Separator a faint hairline.

sections.name: contact
sections.what: A MoodMeter budget pad with a ReasonTag readout beside a brief Card (Composer + Progress + send), with a received success state.
sections.restyle: MoodMeter color set to the one blue var; Card forced to a flat near-black hairline panel (no kit shadow); Composer/inputs get near-black fields + blue focus ring; Progress track is a hairline, bar is the one blue; Tooltip surface darkened.

sections.name: footer
sections.what: Brand mark + studio line, mono link grid, fictional-studio note + back-to-gallery link.
sections.restyle: Mono link grid that turns blue on hover; a faint blue-bleed hairline rule; back link in the one accent.

palette.restyle: Two roles only: primary = solid blue (#3b82f6) with a soft glow box-shadow and a 9px radius; ghost = transparent with a hairline border that turns blue on hover. Disabled drops to 45% opacity, no glow.
Reskinned to a mono uppercase 'tag' — hairline border, near-black fill, +0.08em tracking; the accent variant tints text + border blue over a 12%-blue wash.
Flattened to a near-black (#101218) panel with a 1px #1d2029 hairline, 12px radius, and NO kit shadow; border brightens to #2a2e3a on hover.
Underline variant; tablist gets a hairline base; tabs become mono uppercase tertiary labels; the active tab is the one blue (no heavy pill).
Hairline-separated rows; medium-weight triggers in primary ink that turn blue on hover; no fills, no chevron color noise.
Transparent dark rows with hairline bottoms; header cells become mono uppercase tertiary labels over a stronger hairline; rows hover-tint to the recessed band.
Dots/connectors recolored to the dark hairline line; exactly one step (the build phase) carries the blue accent to mark the moment design becomes code.
Near-black field, hairline border, blue focus ring; chips read as small dark mono tags consistent with Badge.
Near-black editable field flush inside the brief Card; border/rounding stripped so it reads as part of the panel; blue focus ring.
Track recolored to a thin hairline; the bar is the one blue (color='blue'), used as a character-count meter.
color set to the single blue var so the budget pad's curve and posted marker match the accent; sits on the near-black page with no extra chrome.
Underline theme so the agentic 'why this number' affordance reads as a quiet inline annotation in mono metadata rather than a colored chip.
Kit fallback initials on the dark surface; no glow ring (reserved emphasis) so the team grid stays restrained.
All inherit the locally re-pointed semantic tokens (fg/border/surface/accent), so they read near-black natively; Tooltip surface is darkened to the raised panel color.

contentArchetype: A fictional design + engineering studio (FIELDWORK) one-page portfolio: hero thesis, client marquee, studio numbers, four capabilities, featured builds + a full project index, a brief→build process, a studio about + team, awards/clients/press, and a budget-aware contact brief. Confident, terse, lower-case-friendly copy; mono numerals and labels everywhere.
remix: Swap the single accent hue to re-theme instantly (one --d-accent var drives buttons, tabs, timeline, progress, glows, focus rings) — try emerald or amber for a different studio voice while keeping the near-black restraint. Because the palette is re-pointed onto the shared semantic tokens under one scope class, the whole look is portable: lift the .insp-dark token block + the dk-* restyle rules into any react-fancy project and the kit instantly wears Dark Studio. Blend with Swiss/Minimal by keeping the modular grid + mono labels and only flipping the surface tokens light↔dark; blend with a bolder editorial style by widening the display type and letting the accent appear in one full-bleed band rather than only in hairlines.
